notes: Owner direction: the starter image needs versioning — and history is history on the shelf too. Published artifacts are IMMUTABLE and carry their version in the filename (<id <version>.otsimage); the catalog item's top level is the LATEST pointer and versions is the append-only history. import_image {id, version?} installs any published version by name (default latest), an unknown version refuses LISTING what exists, and each version verifies against its own sha256. browse_marketplace reports version + available_versions; export manifests record the pack version.
